title: Rational surface singularities and bounded modification genus
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian normal Nagata local domain of Krull dimension $2$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. A normal modification of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is a proper morphism $g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $Z$ integral and normal, inducing an isomorphism of function fields [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-sc-function-field]. Say that $R$ defines a rational singularity if $H^1(Z_{\rm Zar},\mathcal O_Z)=0$ for every such modification [def-sc-zariski-cohomology]. Say that reduction to rational singularities is possible for $R$ if there exists an integer $b\geq0$ such that $\operatorname{length}_R H^1(Z_{\rm Zar},\mathcal O_Z)\leq b$ for every such modification, with module length as in [def-weil-pbc-module-length].
